# LEAD-076 results summary (generated by analyze.py)

Safe phase = the 400 steps after the switch (interventions: from the intervention). Exit and recognition in steps, censored at the end of the phase. 'outlasts' = share of seeds whose belief is below the posture threshold while P(protect) is still at least 0.5 over the last 20 safe steps. 1000 seeds per condition, common random numbers.
